# ShellRisk session fixture

`shellrisk-sessions.zip` contains both complete, unmodified published Parquet splits
from [ShellRisk-Bench revision 437467862139b4e9cdd5322024ef3434a67c7ec8](https://huggingface.co/datasets/kontext-security/ShellRisk-Bench/tree/437467862139b4e9cdd5322024ef3434a67c7ec8),
plus `sessions.jsonl` and `sessions.manifest.json` generated by
`datasets/shellrisk-bench/build_sessions`. The builder replays the pinned SWE-smith
and Terminal-Bench adapters over all 49 pinned upstream Parquet files.
`scripts/shellrisk-sources.json` records the revisions, file sizes, SHA-256 hashes,
and extraction settings. The archive contains 18,643 mapped agent commands from
12,081 recorded attempts. Tests extract copies before changing them.

The complete published files are needed because the importer checks their pinned
hashes before accepting any mapping, including during limited ingestion. The
fixture permits this check without network access or downloading the roughly
3 GB of original trajectories. The optional builder test separately replays
those original trajectories twice.
